feature: DHCPDISCOVER answered with an OFFER
note: The address comes from `acquire_lease`; the case gives the client a static address.

feature: OFFER to a client with no address and the broadcast flag clear
note: Broadcast, unless `UNICAST_TO_UNCONFIGURED_CLIENT` is set.

feature: DISCOVER through a relay (giaddr set, option 82 present)
note: The option 82 is echoed last.

feature: An offered address held for its client
note: A second client is left unanswered while the only address is on offer.

feature: REQUEST in SELECTING answered with an ACK
REQUEST for another address than the one offered, answered with a NAK
REQUEST in INIT-REBOOT
INIT-REBOOT from a client the server knows nothing about
note: Silence.

feature: INIT-REBOOT for an address on another network, answered with a NAK
REQUEST in RENEWING
The port a renewal's ACK goes to
note: Port 68 in the default strict mode.

feature: REQUEST in REBINDING
note: Answered like RENEWING; no case asks the broadcast shape.

feature: The client's host name (option 12) in the ACK
note: Not echoed.

feature: DHCPINFORM answered with an ACK that carries no address
DHCPRELEASE
DHCPDECLINE of an address the sender holds
note: The address is quarantined.

feature: DHCPDECLINE from a sender that holds no lease
note: Ignored; an open difference.

feature: Renewal and rebinding times (options 58 and 59) in OFFER and ACK
note: Not sent; an open difference.

feature: An address pool
note: The stock server has no pool: a subclass supplies leases through `acquire_lease`.

feature: Static host-to-address assignments
note: Through a subclass, as for a pool.

feature: BOOTP clients with no message type option
note: The server dispatches on the message type option.

feature: Rapid commit
note: The option is decoded; the two-message exchange is not served.

feature: PXE and proxy DHCP
note: The boot file and server name fields are carried; no PXE logic.

feature: Lease persistence
note: `FileLeaseBackend` writes a JSON file; no recorded case.

feature: DHCPv6
note: Out of scope.

feature: DHCPDISCOVER
REQUEST in SELECTING after an OFFER
REQUEST in INIT-REBOOT
DHCPRELEASE
DHCPDECLINE
DHCPINFORM
note: dhclient sends none, so there is nothing to record.

feature: REQUEST in RENEWING and REBINDING, with lease timers
note: The caller builds the REQUEST; the client keeps no lease timers.

feature: Configuring the network interface with the lease
note: The client does not change the host's addresses.

feature: DHCPv6
note: Out of scope.

feature: A client's DISCOVER relayed to the server
note: giaddr stamped, hops incremented.

feature: A server's OFFER relayed to the client
The hop limit
note: Requests above 4 hops are dropped by default; `max_hops` sets it.

feature: A request another relay already stamped
note: giaddr is kept.

feature: Relay agent information (option 82) inserted
note: Opt-in (`insert_relay_agent_info`); no recorded case.
